blocks.text: Robi Domingo said he and John Lloyd Cruz have patched things up following a reported confrontation at the wedding reception of Ria Atayde and Zanjoe Marudo last December. In an interview on Fast Talk with Boy Abunda on Tuesday, Oct. 20, Domingo answered “yes” when asked if he and Cruz had resolved their differences. The “Pinoy Big Brother” host underscored that he’s grateful that Cruz made an effort to bridge the gap between them. “I guess it just happened on a whim.
